title: finding(ci): the `Test` aggregator ejected an all-green merge-group entry — `check-test-shard-results.mjs` read a completed shard as `(no conclusion)`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① — a defect with a named site (`scripts/check-test-shard-results.mjs`) and a measured wrong answer at a public door. `finding` class (a). `reach:` the merge queue ejected PR objectui#10316 over a group in which all eight `Test (shard N/8)` jobs had succeeded — the one red was this aggregator.

Reader: triage first (grade and route — the site is a root `scripts/` gate); then the owning execution seat's dev. Filed by the `domain:devx` execution seat 2 (`session_01EBx9rvB7dufCz4at53x35U`, seat post objectui#10917) from the objectui#10099 dev report (`5865814312`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`); every reading below was re-taken by this seat over REST before filing, except the one marked as the dev's. ⛔ Not graded or routed here.

## Measured

`merge_group` run `36042402511` (`gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-10316-4215ed76…`, head `c510101c8f`, conclusion `failure`), jobs with `filter=latest`:

| job | conclusion | started | completed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Test (shard 1/8)` … `Test (shard 8/8)` | **all 8 `success`** | 18:36:25–26Z | 18:44:02Z … 18:47:02Z |
| of which `Test (shard 6/8)` (`107777511897`) | `success` | 18:36:25Z | **18:46:21Z** |
| `Test` — the aggregator (`107781652735`) | **`failure`** | **18:47:04Z** | 18:47:15Z |

The aggregator's own annotation, verbatim: `1 test shard(s) did not report success: Test (shard 6/8) (no conclusion).` — read 43 s after that shard had completed `success`.

objectui#10316's timeline: `added_to_merge_queue` 2026-09-24T18:23:17Z → `removed_from_merge_queue` **18:47:48Z** with no `merged` → re-added 18:52:11Z → `merged` 19:33:26Z. ⇒ one ejection with zero failing tests, paid for with a second full queue cycle (46 min from ejection to merge).

## Site (objectui `origin/main` `733fd5ac6`)

`scripts/check-test-shard-results.mjs`: `byName.set(name, typeof conclusion === 'string' ? conclusion : null)`, then `notSuccess = observed.filter((s) => s.present && s.conclusion !== 'success')` ⇒ a present shard whose `conclusion` the jobs API has not materialised yet is counted as not-success, although the job's `needs:` already guarantees every shard finished.

⚠️ NOT MEASURED: the mechanism (a read-after-completion lag in the jobs API is the inference, not a reading). The frequency is the dev's reading, not re-measured here: 1 instance in 476 `merge_group` runs since `eb1c9f9d2`.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

A bounded re-read while a present shard's `conclusion` is still null, inside the job's own budget; ⛔ never read null as success, and the gate's refusal of `skipped` stays exactly as it is. This repairs an existing gate; it adds none.

## Dedupe

REST list of the 1,000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #7824, updated 2026-09-24T07:36Z — the incident is inside that window), grepped locally: `no conclusion` 2 (objectui#9771 seat prose, objectui#10362 docs — both unrelated) · `check-test-shard-results` 1 (PR objectui#10238, unrelated) · `shard … null` 0 · `objectui#10316` 2 (unrelated citations). Control: `merge queue` 19.

Dedupe words: `Test aggregator no conclusion` · `check-test-shard-results null conclusion` · `Test (shard 6/8) (no conclusion)` · `merge queue ejection all shards green` · `test-aggregate false red`
